sql: SELECT d.driver_code, q.quali_position, r.finish_position FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id=q.driver_id LEFT JOIN results r ON r.round=q.round AND r.driver_id=q.driver_id WHERE q.round=9 AND q.quali_position<=5 ORDER BY q.quali_position

SELECT d.driver_code, r.constructor_id, r.points, ROUND(100.0*r.points/SUM(r.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.constructor_id),2) AS pct FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id=r.driver_id WHERE r.round=9 AND r.points>0 ORDER BY r.constructor_id, pct DESC

SELECT d.driver_code, ROUND(r.fastest_lap_seconds-(SELECT MIN(fastest_lap_seconds) FROM results WHERE round=9),3) AS gap_seconds FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id=r.driver_id WHERE r.round=9 AND r.fastest_lap_seconds-(SELECT MIN(fastest_lap_seconds) FROM results WHERE round=9)<=1.5 ORDER BY gap_seconds, d.driver_code

SELECT d.driver_id, COALESCE(s.points,0)+COALESCE(r.points,0) AS total_points FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN sprint_results s ON s.driver_id=d.driver_id AND s.round=9 LEFT JOIN results r ON r.driver_id=d.driver_id AND r.round=9 WHERE COALESCE(s.points,0)>0 OR COALESCE(r.points,0)>0 ORDER BY total_points DESC, d.driver_id
SELECT given_name, family_name FROM drivers WHERE date_of_birth<'1990-01-01' ORDER BY family_name, given_name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM constructors WHERE nationality='Italian'
SELECT race_name, race_date FROM races WHERE round=11

SELECT c.constructor_name, COUNT(*) AS driver_count FROM driver_standings ds JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id=ds.constructor_id WHERE ds.round=9 GROUP BY c.constructor_id, c.constructor_name ORDER BY c.constructor_name
SELECT d.driver_code, r.status FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id=r.driver_id WHERE r.round=9 AND r.position_text='R' ORDER BY d.driver_code
SELECT c.country, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuit_id=r.circuit_id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY c.country
SELECT d.driver_code, q.q3_time FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id=q.driver_id WHERE q.round=9 AND q.q3_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY q.q3_time, d.driver_code

WITH t AS (SELECT r.constructor_id, p.driver_id, SUM(p.duration_seconds) AS tot FROM pit_stops p JOIN results r ON r.round=p.round AND r.driver_id=p.driver_id WHERE p.round=9 GROUP BY r.constructor_id, p.driver_id HAVING COUNT(*)>=2) SELECT c.constructor_name, d.driver_code, ROUND(t.tot,2) AS total_duration, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.constructor_id ORDER BY t.tot DESC) AS rnk FROM t JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id=t.constructor_id JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id=t.driver_id

WITH x AS (SELECT ds.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ds.constructor_id ORDER BY ds.standing_position, ds.driver_id) AS rn FROM driver_standings ds WHERE ds.round=9) SELECT c.constructor_name, d.driver_code, x.standing_position, x.points FROM x JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id=x.constructor_id JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id=x.driver_id WHERE rn=1

SELECT ra.round, ra.race_name, (SELECT SUM(points) FROM sprint_results s WHERE s.round=ra.round) AS sprint_points, (SELECT SUM(points) FROM results r WHERE r.round=ra.round) AS race_points, ROUND(100.0*(SELECT SUM(points) FROM sprint_results s WHERE s.round=ra.round)/((SELECT SUM(points) FROM sprint_results s WHERE s.round=ra.round)+(SELECT SUM(points) FROM results r WHERE r.round=ra.round)),2) AS sprint_pct FROM races ra WHERE ra.has_sprint=1 ORDER BY ra.round
